correctness.rationale: Explicitly partition the first-repeat orbit by whether the hub 0 occurs and its location: the two falling-factorial common terms reproduce every Q_n(t,j), including t=1 and j=0, with masses summing to one. Labels are sampled independently on distinct transient and cycle vertices so the finite joint pgf follows from conditioning. For p_n sqrt(n)->a, factorial tails give (1+ar)exp(-r^2/2-ar), per-cell density n Q_n(t,j)->(1+a^2+ar)exp(-r^2/2-ar) uniformly in interior, yielding independent uniform split fraction U; bounded rare-label binomials converge jointly to the stated conditional independent Poissons. At a=0 covariance c_i c_j(1/3-pi/8) is negative. When np_n^2->infinity and p_n->0, two hub hits precede nonhub collision with probability 1-O((np_n^2)^-1), hence independent geometric waits become Exp(1) lengths and conditional marked counts integrate to independent multivariate geometric vectors. Independently enumerated all n=2..4 successor functions under three rational hub probabilities, reproducing each exact Q cell and normalization. Limit law is analytically proved, not inferred from finite maps.
